shortDefinition: The coordination of multiple AI agents or tools to complete a larger task.
fullDefinition: Orchestration in AI refers to managing and coordinating multiple components — models, agents, tools, APIs — to complete complex tasks. An orchestrator system receives a high-level goal, breaks it into sub-tasks, assigns them to appropriate agents or tools, manages dependencies, and assembles the final result. Frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI are orchestration tools.
examples: A research pipeline that orchestrates web search, summarization, and report formatting agents
Microsoft AutoGen coordinating multiple specialized AI agents on a software project
